visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with black-rimmed glasses and short black hair wearing a tan linen shirt sits in a brightly lit studio. He speaks directly to the camera with animated hand gestures. Behind him is a professional Shure microphone and a window with horizontal blinds. (2) Transition to an illustration of an elderly man in a dark blue traditional Japanese robe sitting in a wood-paneled room. He is meticulously arranging scrolls and stacks of money on low wooden tables. Outside the window, a stone lantern and pine trees are visible. (3) The scene shifts to the same room at night. The man is now using a single light source to examine scrolls. The background shows rolls of tatami material and a small bonsai plant under warm, dim lighting. (4) An illustration of a lively, brightly lit Japanese Izakaya filled with people cheering and holding up mugs of beer. The atmosphere is festive with colorful paper lanterns hanging from the ceiling and steam rising from food on the tables. (5) A split-screen montage showing multiple perspectives of different Izakayas at night, emphasizing the social density and warm, glowing atmosphere of the establishments. (6) A close-up illustration depicts a group of friends at a low table; a spilled glass of beer lies on the tatami mat, with one person using a cloth to wipe up the liquid while others look on. (7) An elderly man in a light-colored apron and headscarf is seen kneeling on a tatami mat in a traditional room, carefully measuring and fitting a replacement mat into the floor. (8) A wider shot shows the man working in a closed restaurant with wooden chairs stacked on tables. He is carrying and laying down new tatami mats across the open floor space. (9) The video returns to the narrator in the beige shirt. He holds up a physical book titled '70 Business Models You Can Use Immediately' in Traditional Chinese, pointing at the cover while continuing his enthusiastic address to the viewers.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 各位朋友大家好. 今天跟大家分享一個非常有趣的賺錢的故事. (2) [Subtitle]: 你知道嗎. 有時候賺錢除了要有好的產品之外, 更重要的是要有好的點子. (3) [Subtitle]: 在日本有一個專門在賣榻榻米的老闆, 他跟別人就是不一樣. (4) [Subtitle]: 別人是白天營業, 他偏偏選擇在半夜的時候營業. (5) [Subtitle]: 結果生意反而比別人還要好. 原來他的秘密就是在他的客戶身上. (6) [Subtitle]: 他的客戶主要是在日本的居酒屋啊. 大家想想看, 居酒屋是什麼時候最忙? 當然是晚上. (7) [Subtitle]: 白天的時候這些店家根本沒有時間來進行榻榻米的更換更維修. (8) [Subtitle]: 因為居酒屋經常遇到緊急狀況, 比如客人不小心打翻了酒, 或者把榻榻米弄髒了甚至是弄破了. (9) [Subtitle]: 店家只能等到下班的時候才能處理這些問題. 這時候就有很多店家急著更換榻榻米. (10) [Subtitle]: 而這個聰明的老闆, 就專門在半夜的時候提供這樣的緊急服務. (11) [Subtitle]: 同樣是賣榻榻米, 但是換個時間來營業, 他就找到了一個完全沒有競爭對手的藍海市場. (12) [Subtitle]: 這是一個非常棒的商業思維. 有時候我們的產品可能不是那麼特別, 而因為你想到一個別人沒有想到的點子, 我們就可以把產品賣得比競爭對手還要好. (13) [Subtitle]: 所以當所有的人都在做同樣的事情的時候, 你能不能換個角度思考? (14) [Subtitle]: 關鍵是在於真正了解你的客戶是什麼時候需要你的服務. (15) [Subtitle]: 那麼這個故事是我從一個70個馬上套用的賺錢模式裡面所看到的. (16) [Subtitle]: 裡面有70個小故事喔. 如果大家覺得今天的分享對大家有幫助的話, 可以訂閱我們的頻道. (17) [Subtitle]: 告訴我你聽過什麼更有趣的賺錢的故事.
